audit.whatIsWrong: The 2+ items row gave K'Sante the win while whys[6], spikes[3] and the late paragraph all say the opposite — full-AP Neeko kites with Shapesplitter, one-shots from fog, and armour does nothing. The packet chart marks that stage Neeko.
audit.why: The row and its own explanation rendered opposite answers, and the enemy's scaling case is the stronger one at 7/10 carry threat.
audit.corrected: 2+ items flipped to Neeko in both layers as a matched pair, and phases[6].why rewritten so the row explains the flip. Earlier rows already agree across layers and match the 52.53% win rate over 533 games.

audit.why: Spikes are ordered correctly: your level-3 combo, level-6 All Out, first tank item, then Neeko's full-AP late window. Pop Blossom is 120/105/90 against All Out's 120/100/80, so at 6 neither ultimate has a standing cooldown edge — worth knowing before you trade one for the other.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two mechanical errors and one that misreads Neeko. (1) 'Q3 knock-up-and-pull' appears four times — Ntofo Strikes slows and, at two stacks, fires a shockwave that PULLS. There is no knock-up on it; Path Maker (W) is the knock-back and stun. (2) spikes[1] says Neeko 'pools the combo' — Neeko has no pool or untargetable escape anywhere in her kit; that is a different champion's mechanic and it changes whether you can finish her. (3) Neeko is referred to as 'he/his' in the trading and don'ts fields.
audit.why: Point 4 is what the player acts on: whether your Q displaces or drags, and whether she can escape your execute, decide whether you commit R.
audit.corrected: Second Ntofo Strikes stack pulls; Path Maker knocks back and stuns; All Out launches her through a wall. Neeko's only escape tool is Shapesplitter (16/15/14/13/12s) — a clone and a move-speed passive, not an untargetable pool. Real cooldowns: Tangle-Barbs 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s at 1000 range, Blooming Burst 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s at 800.

audit.why: The page already carries the genuinely hidden mechanic: Riot's own R text says 'The preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised', which is exactly the fog one-shot the late paragraph warns about, and the passive breaks disguise on immobilizing CC — your Q pull or W stun reveals a disguised Neeko. Left intact.
